messages:
angela: quick check — I ran integration tests for python+ts SDKs vs REST and found several contract diffs that could affect production apps. can we sync?

matt: which diffs?

angela: summary:
- python sends snake_case params (e.g., max_tokens) while REST prefers camelCase (maxTokens) in a few internal proxies. TS uses camelCase.
- python default for `stream` is True, but REST default is false -> causes unexpected streaming for upgraded clients.
- python omits `stop` when None; TS sends `stop: null`. Legacy models treat omitted vs null differently (different truncation behavior).

sam: hit the stream default issue upgrading the demo app, not fun.

anais: also a minor one: TS SDK normalizes chat responses to {choices:[{message:{role,content}}]}, while some internal consumers still expect {choices:[{text:"..."}]}. we should document or provide a helper.

matt: for casing we can do python-side normalization (snake_case -> camelCase) before sending. cheap compatibility fix.

angela: will implement normalization and change python `stream` default to explicit false in a minor patch. i'll add unit tests for payload normalization and a small e2e against staging.

sam: prefer explicit false so apps that relied on streaming earlier don't break. mark as semver minor and call out in changelog.

ryan: server-side treating null == omitted for `stop` would be ideal but that's a product change. SDK should match current REST semantics: omit key when None.

ci-bot: build #4821 for branch fix/sdk-compat — success ✅

lisa: tagging @matt @ryan — can someone review angela's PR when it lands? i can smoke-test with the demo.

angela: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/312 — reviewers: @matt @lisa. included tests and changelog note.

matt: thanks. also add a short note in the SDK migration guide about casing, stream default, and response-shape differences.

angela: filing a follow-up issue for response-shape helpers. not blocking this fix. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
